name: Robert Torricelli
summary: Robert Guy Torricelli (born August 27, 1951) is an American attorney, real estate developer, consultant, and former Democratic Party politician who represented New Jersey in the United States House of Representatives from 1983 to 1997 and the United States Senate from 1997 to 2003. In the House, he represented the state's 9th congressional district, which centered on Bergen County. He also chaired the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee during the 2000 elections.
